newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas shares end up slightly, waiting for CANTV.
newsitem.headline: Caracas shares end up slightly, waiting for CANTV.

text.p: Share prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange closed slightly up with all eyes in the market already on the upcoming and unprecedented global share offering of telephone company CANTV, traders said.
The market's 19-share index finished up 0.41 percent at 5,912.15 points. A total 20 shares rose, 13 fell and seven closed flat.
"What's going to happen on the Bolsa after the CANTV privatization is uncharted territory. Never has Venezuela seen such a massive share offering," one trader said.
Fifty million shares of a total 289 million up for grabs will be offered on the local market.
A total 15.5 million shares traded Friday, worth 4.63 billion bolivars ($9.85 million), a relatively light volume.
"Investors are absent, foreigners in particular. They are awaiting the sale of CANTV," another trader said.
